verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is documented as a self-hosted AI platform built to run entirely offline. It installs via pip, uv, Docker, Kubernetes or bare metal, with a one-command Docker quick start and an air-gapped deployment option. Community users describe running it themselves (complaining about large Docker images), which corroborates real self-hosting, but none give a detailed deployment walkthrough. Missing for 10: detailed independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and lightweight deployment options (community reports huge container images even for API-only use).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal)
Install seamlessly via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
